data.description: Dr. Esam Nahlah 🦷 💻 https://www.drnahlah.com/ ----- Melanie: My name is Melanie. I had the all-on-4 with Dr. Nahlah. I had years of wanting and knowing that I needed to get work done. I spent years feeling embarrassed, insecure, not smiling, and wanting to trust a dentist but not knowing who's going to be that person that I'm going to give this over to, because I've got a lot to give over to them. I have anxiety when it comes to dentists. It's not my favorite place to be or go. So if I don't have to go, I'm not going to want to go. I know my procrastination was probably part of it, but I still felt like it was me not getting what I wanted in terms of patient care. And so, I went to various people after I said, "Okay, I've got to do something." It's coming down to the wire. I can't really smile and be as confident. I'm a teacher, so I have to talk. As you know, schools were virtual and everyday, like clockwork, after Zoom was over for my morning class, Great Day Washington would come on. I saw a couple of segments where they featured Dr. Nahlah, but what caught my attention was they featured one of- It was twice I saw 2 patients, and their testimony or what they were saying caught my attention. But more importantly, it was their smile. You wouldn't have been able to tell that they had had any work. It genuinely looked natural. They looked happy. They spoke his praises. And I was like, "Okay. Yeah, is this an infomercial?" But it didn't read like an infomercial. So, I made the call, and I came. It was when I came here that changed everything for me because the office, the staff, everyone just seemed knowledgeable. They were very clear about what the process was, what the cost was. Everything was so transparent that it was either yes or no. And that's really where I want it to be, to be able to make a decision and know that I was making the best decision for what I expected the outcome to be. Dr. Esam Nahlah: For Melanie, when she came to our practice, she was very frustrated about her smile. She has a bridge in her front teeth that she wasn't happy about the looking. There was a lot of resorption in her gum. We were able to design the smile. When she came on the day of the procedure, we had her upper teeth extracted and we placed implants, and gave her a fixed bridge on top of the implants on the same day. Melanie: This was everything that was holding me back in terms of what I didn't feel really demonstrated how I felt on certain days and how I wanted to express myself. And knowing that that is behind me, that smile is gone and I have a new smile, that's amazing. It ended up being one of those things that looking back, it was the best decision that I think that I've made because he is the best dentist that I've had. ----- Dr. Esam Nahlah has practiced implant dentistry, aesthetic dentistry, and prosthodontics for over 20 years. In 2013, the American Board of Prosthodontics awarded Dr. Nahlah the most prestigious award in the field: "Diplomate of American Board of Prosthodontics." As a Board-Certified specialist in Prosthodontic Dentistry, Dr. Nahlah utilizes the latest technological innovations in dentistry such as immediate placement and restoration of implants, teeth in a day, computer-guided surgery, digital smile design, IV sedation, digital impressions, full mouth rehabilitation, veneers, and porcelain crowns for a new smile. Dr. Nahlah takes great pride in ensuring that every patient receives comfortable dental care of the highest quality available. ----- Contact Us! 💻 https://www.drnahlah.com/ 📞 (703) 448-3312 📍 7901 Jones Branch Dr., Suite 220 McLean, VA 22102
